FLUX.2 Klein 4B via mflux. Primary: pre-quantized 4-bit community export (4.3 GB, fast cold-load, requires mflux >= 0.16; licence CONFIRMED apache-2.0 via HF model card metadata, issue #124 OQ-A — same terms as the base model, no relicensing). Fallback: black-forest-labs/FLUX.2-klein-4B (Apache 2.0, ~13 GB, quantized 4-bit on load). default_steps 4 is the family-native distilled value; render_steps 20 is what the pipeline passes — the 2026-07-11 dogfood showed 4B reaches Klein-9b grade at 20 steps + annotation pattern. MLX default draft model. Horizon-2 gate: Phase 5 dogfood must beat/match the Ollama Klein-9b 8/9 baseline before promotion into role_defaults.local_draft. Field finding 2026-07-15: mflux 0.18.0 writes a literal-null .metadata.json sidecar for this family; generation metadata IS embedded in the PNG XMP/IPTC — consumers must not rely on the sidecar.

Z-Image-Turbo via mflux, requires mflux >= 0.13. SMOKE RESULT 2026-07-16 (M2 Max 32 GB, 9 steps, seed 42): 9/10 on BOTH the exact-spellings and natural-prose dialects — labels letter-perfect, flat clean white background (flat-field noise sigma 0.43, statistically identical to Klein's 0.42), no grain, ~62 s/render at 1024x576. The Ollama-variant retirement for schema figures (2026-07-11 dogfood: paradigm drift on prose, 1-2/9) does NOT reproduce in this mflux 4-bit port — that verdict was variant-specific. First-class draft model alongside Klein 4B. BENCHMARK 2026-07-17: best LOCAL text all-rounder (7.05 overall blind; outright quote-card winner in both aspects; fastest in fleet ~82 s) — preferred local draft for text-bearing figures. LICENCE NOTE (issue #124 review M6, CONFIRMED via HF model card metadata): the pre-quantized primary repo filipstrand/Z-Image-Turbo-mflux-4bit is licensed 'tongyi-qianwen-license' (license:other tag), NOT Apache 2.0 — the derivative repo's licence governs the download. Operators needing pure Apache 2.0 should pull the fallback Tongyi-MAI/Z-Image-Turbo (Apache 2.0, confirmed via HF model card, full precision, quantized 4-bit on load) instead. 9-step distilled (render_steps == default_steps). timeout_seconds 180 is a conservative placeholder — Mac wall-clock unpublished; Phase 5 measures (proposal risk 2).

Qwen-Image via mflux, requires mflux >= 0.11. REPO SWAP 2026-07-15 (issue #296 upstream): the previous primary filipstrand/Qwen-Image-mflux-6bit was saved with mflux 0.11.0 (safetensors header metadata) and is BROKEN on mflux >= 0.13 — the v0.13 weight-loading refactor broke all pre-0.13 pre-quantized exports (https://github.com/filipstrand/mflux/issues/296, open; maintainer acknowledged 2025-12-17, HF weights never re-uploaded). Failure mode: quantized text-encoder embedding not reconstructed — packed U32 rows (broadcast_shapes (3584) vs (1,N,672)). Do NOT reuse that repo. New primary OsaurusAI/Qwen-Image-mflux-4bit: 25.9 GB, license apache-2.0 (verified via HF API cardData 2026-07-15), ungated, quantized WITH mflux 0.18 (the version this pipeline targets) — mflux-format exports record mflux_version in their safetensors headers, so version-matched saves are the fix. SMOKE RESULT 2026-07-15 (M2 Max 32 GB): loads + renders OK on mflux 0.18.0 — confirms the vintage diagnosis (52 s load-test; 5m35s at 1024x576/20 steps, no OOM without --low-ram). BUT text fidelity at 4-bit scored 4/10 vs Klein 4B's 9/10 on the identical exact-spellings prompt/seed (misspelled label 'Publiish', hallucinated garbled banner, noisy non-white background) — consistent with the upstream quantization-degradation caution below. DEFINITIVE ISOLATION SERIES 2026-07-16 (5 renders, seed 42): (1) PROMPT DIALECT is decisive — Klein-style patterns (letter-by-letter spell-outs, 'box one' meta-language) produce garbled labels + hallucinated captions; natural prose with double-quoted labels ('a box labeled "Publish"') produced letter-perfect text in 3/3 renders (community-measured ~96% quoted vs ~65% unquoted). (2) Negative prompts are PLACEBO — Qwen-Image is not trained on negative conditioning; pass ' '. (3) The grain is PER-STEP COMPOUNDING QUANTIZATION ERROR, not a fixed floor: flat-field sweep (512px, seed 42) shows high-freq noise growing monotonically with steps (sigma 2.48 @ 4 steps -> 4.14 @ 8 -> 6.42 @ 20 -> 7.36 @ 50) while whites drift dingy (252 -> 224) — every step passes through the q4 transformer, so more steps = more accumulated error. The canonical more-steps-better recipe is INVERTED on this export (same pathology class as the Klein F8 step-curve finding). (4) Practical curve is U-shaped: 4 steps under-forms structure (ghost outlines, chroma fringing on glyphs, 3/10); 8 STEPS IS THE SWEET SPOT — 7/10 (perfect text, solid structure, lighter-but-visible grain) at ~2.5 min, matching the 30-step score at 3.4x less time. render_steps set to 8 on this evidence. (5) The 7/10 grain ceiling stands at every tested config — vs Klein 4B 9/10 in 35 s. VERDICT: usable-with-caveats for schema work at 8 steps if Klein is unavailable; never preferred over Klein. Better ceiling needs the 8-bit export (36 GB, >=48 GB machines) or the post-#420 mixed-precision 4-bit. text_rendering downgraded excellent -> good: 'excellent' described full precision, not this tier. Fallback stays Qwen/Qwen-Image (apache-2.0) but its true size is ~58 GB (upstream qwen README), not the ~40 GB previously documented; mflux-save local re-quantization is NOT viable under ~57 GB free RAM (no layer-streaming, confirmed from mflux source). Upstream quality note (mflux qwen README): '6-bit or below can degrade the image a lot more compared to Flux' — quantization quality must be evaluated in Phase 5; 0.18-era saves are mixed-precision (hence 4-bit = 25.9 GB). min_ram_gb 32 sized for the 4-bit primary (25.9 GB weights + activations; operators should pass --low-ram if headroom is tight). Strongest open-weights in-image text renderer AT FULL PRECISION; the 4-bit tier this entry ships did not show that advantage in the 2026-07-15 smoke. Upstream README examples use --steps 30; render_steps stays 20 (mflux family default) pending Phase 5 measurement. timeout_seconds 900 remains a placeholder pending Phase 5 (§10 OQ-B).
